description: CUR-ID and DAO-ID, variant: what does a retained Field of a recordset read after its row is deleted and a row of the same key is reinserted by another call? A dynaset on T at ID 3 holds Field N (and S); the Database deletes ID 3; the held Field is read; ID 3 is reinserted (N 333); read again; Move 0; read again; MoveFirst then MoveNext twice, reading ID and the held Field; Requery; read.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
